whyTrulab.title: One team for your content, from the first idea to the final file.
whyTrulab.description: Working with a different vendor for every job means more briefing, more chasing and a brand that looks different everywhere. {company} plans, produces and delivers it all, so your content stays consistent and you only deal with one team.
points: One team for podcasts, video, photography, design, websites, marketing and branding.
Built for government bodies, SMEs, private companies, brands, creators and organisations.
We come to you: on-location shoots at your office, venue or event, anywhere in Malaysia.
Multi-camera video and professional lighting for podcasts, corporate videos and events.
Every shoot turned into more content: short clips, photos and posts for social media.
Clean audio, clean visuals and a consistent look that builds trust with your audience.
Registered with MOF and recognised by FINAS and FDAM for corporate and government work.

process.title: A clear process from first conversation to final delivery.

items.title: Consultation
items.description: Understand your goals, audience, budget and what you need produced.

items.title: Planning
items.description: Shape the concept, script or talking points, schedule and technical setup.

items.title: Production
items.description: Shoot, record, photograph or design, on location, remotely or in a venue we arrange.

items.title: Editing
items.description: Edit, colour grade, retouch and refine until every piece looks and sounds right.

items.title: Delivery
items.description: Export final files in the right formats for each platform, team and campaign.

items.title: Growth
items.description: Turn the best moments into clips, posts and campaigns that keep your brand visible.

certifications.title: Registered and recognised for corporate and government work.

coverage.title: Creative production that comes to you.
paragraphs: Whether you are based in Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Putrajaya, Johor, Penang, Sabah, Sarawak or anywhere across Malaysia, {company} brings the cameras, lights, microphones and crew to your office, venue or event.
Need a corporate podcast, a company video, event photography, a new website or a full brand identity? {company} works as your in-house creative team, without the cost of hiring one.

contact.title: Book a Free Consultation
contact.description: Tell us what you want to produce, who it is for and when you need it. {company} will suggest the right approach and send you a quote.

footer.description: Podcast production, video production, photography, design, websites, marketing and branding for brands, organisations, SMEs, creators and government bodies in Malaysia.
